name: Miranda Jahana
source:
[url=/c6820]Reimi[/url]'s mother and the true head of the Jahana Group, which supervises the V.G. tournaments. She had hoped to create the ultimate fighting machine using data collected from the fighters in her tournaments. After the Material units are disabled, she engages [url=/c6815]Yuka[/url], who is able to match her in strength. After being somewhat weakened by this exchange, she is attacked by [url=/c6822]Tamao[/url], who is barely able to defeat her. Following this, she is caught in a combined attack by both Yuka and Tamao and is presumed dead, although she makes a cameo appearance in a background in V.G. Max.

[Taken from [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Variable_Geo]Wikipedia[/url].]
